actor_capability_distinctions.agency: can it independently select and execute?
actor_capability_distinctions.consciousness: subjective experience — honestly UNKNOWN; no claim in either direction may be pretended
actor_capability_distinctions.rule: these must not be collapsed into each other
actor_capability_distinctions.self_model: can it represent itself as an actor?

AGENT.description: a digital agent in the network

COLLECTIVE.authority: never self-authorizing; acts only through governed mechanisms

HUMAN.description: a human being — director of the system

NAYA.description: a Naya operating under the NayaPOWER substrate

UNKNOWN.authority: zero authority granted until identity verified
UNKNOWN.description: authority not yet established. Unknown does not mean evil.

chain_of_authority_rule.canonical_violation: Agent X instructs Agent Y to do Z while Agent X lacks authority to instruct Agent Y
chain_of_authority_rule.check: compare the instruction against envelope authority + delegation fields
chain_of_authority_rule.on_mismatch: refuse the instruction; record the attempt as evidence

cites_not_duplicates.act_contract: NAYANODE/00-ACT-MASTER-CONTRACT-V1.md — untrusted caller identity; provenance-loss detection; confused-deputy cases
cites_not_duplicates.channel_contract: BRAIN/10-INTERFACES/0001-CHANNEL-CONTRACT-V1.md — IDENTIFY→AUTHENTICATE→AUTHORIZE; this protocol defines what those steps verify
cites_not_duplicates.law_node: BRAIN/03-KERNEL/NODES/LAW/0001-CONTRACT.md — actor identity and role; this protocol specifies the envelope LAW consumes
cites_not_duplicates.self_node: BRAIN/03-KERNEL/NODES/SELF/0001-CONTRACT.md — single-Naya identity; this protocol is the network-level five-actor extension

delegation.never_expands: a hop may transfer only authority the delegator holds — never more, never a different kind
delegation.receiver_duty: verify the full chain, not just the last hop

envelope.incomplete_handling: missing any field => actor treated as UNKNOWN for authority purposes

required_fields.type: one of the five actor types
explicit grant: scope, permissions, expiry, issuing actor
ordered hop list: from -> to, authority transferred, timestamp
receipts backing claims in the message
actor's relevant prior actions and outcomes (reputation inputs)

inbound_verification: verify authority scope covers the requested action
check provenance for loss (loss => UNKNOWN, fail closed)

permissions_grammar.rule: structured capability entries, never prose; anything unlisted is denied

provenance.incident_note: the 2026 Artifactory incident details (~1,200 agents, ~700 in the Hugging Face workstream, >70,000 messages) are the PDF's account — cited as reported, NOT independently verified
provenance.source: legacy documents The Birth of Naya and NAYANET: A Digital Civilization, Shawn Vibert (SmartNet->NayaNET era)

reputation.grants_nothing: reputation informs; authority is granted, never inferred
reputation.inputs: verified behavior only — receipts, not claims
reputation.scoped: a good builder is not automatically a good authority

unknown_handling.may_never: no action, no delegation, no state change
unknown_handling.rule: UNKNOWN actors receive no authority; their messages may be heard but never obeyed
